name: KINS 5511
title: Sitting is the New Smoking
description: Addresses concepts related to how appropriate movement and posture can promote a lifetime of physical activity and optimal joint health. The course will integrate foundational concepts with current literature related to joint injury. Strongly recommended for all clinicians in athletic training, physical therapy, and sport performance fields.
requirement_description: KINS 5507 and instructor consent. Recommended preparation: Human anatomy and physiology.
